inputs.name: Hilbert Eisenstein series, rational Fourier expansion and holomorphic decomposition
inputs.statement: Weight-one E_1(1,zeta) for nontrivial totally odd finite zeta has divisor-sum positive coefficients and constant 2^-d L(zeta,0) on every narrow-class component; higher-weight holomorphic eigenforms have the cuspidal/Eisenstein dichotomy.
inputs.source: Dasgupta--Darmon--Pollack, Hilbert modular forms and the Gross--Stark conjecture, Annals174(2011),439--484
inputs.scope_match: eta=1 has conductor1; zeta has nontrivial conductor from norm2 inertia, so no second weight-one constant term occurs. Degeneracy normalization and cusp exclusion are proved explicitly.

inputs.name: Canonical determinant Hasse invariant and high-power integral lift
inputs.statement: At good unramified ell level, the determinant Hasse invariant extends to the minimal compactification, is functorial under prime-to-ell isogenies and has Tate-cusp expansion1; every sufficiently high power lifts by Serre vanishing.
inputs.source: Mok--Tan, Overconvergent Families of Siegel--Hilbert Modular Forms, CJM67(2015),893--922
inputs.scope_match: Genus1, real quadratic F0, ell split. SX2 proves finite deck and central ideal-class product descent; even starting exponent makes normalized rational norm factors congruent1. No division by the class number or deck-group order.

inputs.name: Fixed-central cuspidal ordinary control and ordinary Galois representation
inputs.statement: With fixed algebraic central character, the cuspidal ordinary Hecke algebra is finite and torsion-free over the component weight algebra. Dominant arithmetic specialization is classical after inverting ell; normalized U operators are preserved. The classical covariant Galois representation has upper beta and lower alpha, with alpha the ordinary quotient and the stated inertia weights.
inputs.source: Hida, Control of nearly ordinary Hecke algebras, Luminy lecture18July2007
inputs.theorem: Theorem1.2; Lemmas2.1--2.2; Theorem2.4; Corollary2.5; Theorem3.1 and Remark3.1
inputs.scope_match: Definite quaternion algebra ramified at both real places and no finite places; original tame character and level fixed. (kappa1,kappa2)=(-t,k+t-1)/(0,k-1), common sumk-1. Residual absolute irreducibility is not required for the characteristic-zero point. r=chi^k r_f^vee reverses the ordinary line exactly.

inputs.name: Cyclic base change and automorphic induction with local compatibility
inputs.statement: Cyclic base change and induction exist for cuspidal GLn, with the self-twist/conjugacy cuspidality criteria and strong local compatibility. The needed solvable base change is a finite chain of cyclic ones.
inputs.source: Arthur--Clozel, Simple Algebras, Base Change, and the Advanced Theory of the Trace Formula(1989); Henniart, Induction automorphe globale pour les corps de nombres(2012)
inputs.scope_match: Only quadratic/abelian extensions and principal-series or unramified local parameters. Unitariy formulation is applied after removing a common real norm twist. The extra |det| in rank4 is proved from the source q^(n-1)/2 normalization.

inputs.name: Normalized polarized CM Galois attachment away from ell
inputs.statement: A regular algebraic cuspidal polarized representation over a CM field has a continuous semisimple Galois representation with Frobenius-semisimplified local compatibility at every place away from ell.
inputs.source: Barnet-Lamb--Gee--Geraghty--Taylor, Potential automorphy and change of weight, Annals179(2014),501--609
inputs.scope_match: Only n=2 on an auxiliary CM quadratic split at the inspected place. Strong irreducibility proves base-change cuspidality; central character supplies polarization, adjusted by the CM quadratic sign. No finite discrete-series-place hypothesis is assumed.

inputs.name: Class field, unit, Chebotarev and local GL2 conductor background
inputs.statement: Local/global Artin reciprocity with geometric convention; Dirichlet units span the logarithmic sum-zero hyperplane; Chebotarev compares continuous traces. Casselman newvector theory bounds local conductor by the chosen level; local GL2 correspondence preserves determinant and Artin conductor, and identifies principal series and special parameters.

inputs.name: Irreducibility of unlinked principal induction
inputs.statement: Normalized induction of cuspidal characters rho_i is irreducible if no rho_j equals |det| rho_i. Applied to four one-dimensional characters.
inputs.source: Bernstein--Zelevinsky, Induced representations of reductive p-adic groups.I, ASENS10(1977),441--472
inputs.scope_match: Strict common half-width window puts each exponent difference strictly between-1 and1, giving exactly the theorem premise.
